subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) Later on the master arriving in the market found Death and asked why she made threatening gesture to his servant. (b) There was a merchant in Baghdad who sent his servant to market to buy provisions. (c) She looked at him making a threatening gesture. (d) He came back white and trembling. (e) She replied that she was surprised to see him in Baghdad. (f) In order to escape Death, he left Baghdad for Samarra riding a horse of his master. (g) She was surprised because she had an appointment with him that night in Samarra. (h) And told his master that he had seen Death in the market disguised as a woman.
guide_solution: b → d → h → c → f → a → e → g There was a merchant in Baghdad who sent his servant to market to buy provisions. He came back white and trembling. And told his master that he had seen Death in the market disguised as a woman. She looked at him making a threatening gesture. In order to escape Death, he left Baghdad for Samarra riding a horse of his master. Later on the master arriving in the market found Death and asked why she made threatening gesture to his servant. She replied that she was surprised to see him in Baghdad. She was surprised because she had an appointment with him that night in Samarra.
